PRESS PDF — Nordhaven room directory card 2025 (single-sided, A6 portrait 105 x 148 mm, 3mm bleed, fonts embedded and outlined-optional). This is the file the printer used last season. Layout to be reverse-engineered into a live InDesign merge template.

VISUAL STRUCTURE (top to bottom):
1. IMAGE BLOCK — full-width photograph of the room, occupying the top ~55% of the card, bled to the top and side edges.
2. ROOM NAME — a single line in the display serif, large (approx 30pt), set at the shortest name in last year's list ('Quay'), so the frame's measure is tight; centred, near-black ink on limewash ground.
3. FLOOR & BED LINE — one line in the neutral grotesque, small caps, e.g. 'GROUND FLOOR · QUEEN'.
4. VIEW LINE — one line, sentence case grotesque, e.g. 'Harbour view'.
5. RATE — one line, grotesque, set small and quiet at the bottom, e.g. '$600 / night'.

MERGE FIELD LABELS (to be mapped from nordhaven_rooms.csv):
<<room_name>>  ->  ROOM NAME block
<<floor>> and <<bed_type>>  ->  FLOOR & BED LINE (composed 'FLOOR · BED')
<<view_line>>  ->  VIEW LINE block
<<nightly_rate>>  ->  RATE block
<<image>>  ->  IMAGE BLOCK (bound through the @-prefixed image column)

NOTE FOR THE PRINTER: near-black ink #14161A on limewash #E7E2D8; the display serif is used ONLY for the room name; rate sits quietly, never as an offer. Card trim 105 x 148 mm.

assets.content:
NORDHAVEN — brand & delivery note (client-supplied)

GROUND
Booking page and lookbook cover both sit on our near-black ground: #14161A. Cut-outs are judged on THIS colour, not on white.

PALETTE
Near-black ink #14161A / Limewash plaster #E7E2D8 / Harbour slate #4A535C / Oak #6B5945 / Brass #A8823E.

THE ONE EXCEPTION
The main room photograph on the booking page stays TRUE COLOUR. A guest paying $600 a night wants to see what the bed and the linen actually look like. Everything else carries the tone. Do not tint the room hero.

PLACEMENTS & DELIVERED SIZES
- Booking page: 3 amenity cut-outs (carafe, robe, brass key fob) composited on #14161A, plus the true-colour room hero.
- Lookbook: a spread (2:1 landscape), delivered as one editable canvas.
- Social: a 4:5 canvas.
- Story: a 9:16 canvas.
(The lookbook spread, the 4:5 social and the 9:16 story all sit in ONE editable file.)

BAND & BOOKER
$600 a night, direct only, design-literate travellers 30-45 who book on aesthetic. Restraint is the product. Rates sit small and quietly. Nothing cheerful or saturated.

SHOOT
Two visits, autumn and winter. They do not match. The winter frames were shot after the blinds were replaced. Bring them onto one base before committing any tone.

ROOM LIST
The room list changes each season, which is why we need the collateral back editable and the cards as a live merge. Three rooms were renamed this season.
